policy.last_change: 4 Mar 2026 (-25bp, eff. 5 Mar); held 9 Apr and 6 May

money_market.source: WIBOR fixings of 26 May 2026 (GPW Benchmark delayed data); repo from the Treasury BondSpot Poland session of 26 May 2026. Funding = nominal-weighted special repo starting within one day, <= 3 days (3.55%).

irs.source: PLN IRS vs 6M WIBOR at the 26 May 2026 close: LSEG end-of-day interbank bid rates in the Erste Bank Polska Codziennik of 27 May 2026 (table headed 26.05.2026; only the 26 May 2026 levels are used). Bid side, so roughly 1-2bp below mid. 7Y not available. PCHIP interpolation through 6M WIBOR and the pillars; beyond 10Y extrapolated.
irs.short_source: PLN IRS at the 26 May 2026 close (LSEG bid via Erste), WIBOR fixings 26 May 2026

curve.source: NSS zero curve fitted to BondSpot closing fixings of 26 May 2026; front end anchored at a 3M zero of 3.78% = average of sub-1Y fixed POLGB yields (PS1026 3.73%, OK0127 3.63%, PS0527 3.98%).
